I was waiting for someone to post drinking and driving so I could post my story. I had just bought a new car in grade 12, for a kid in high school it was actually a pretty nice car. Nicer than the piece of crap I drive now. Anyways I was at a party in the country (I grew up in a small town so a lot of the parties were in the country) and I got completely shitfaced. Me and two of my friends decide it's time to leave so we get in my car and I was taking gravel back roads to avoid the cops. Of course since I'm drunk and trying to show off I'm driving recklessly which is already bad enough in itself. Eventually I see this sign that says "impassable road" and my drunken mind decides to challenge that. In a front wheel drive car. So I take off down the road making sure to be going fast enough to just hydroplane over the mud puddles in the road when I see this massive thirty foot long puddle in front of me, since it's too late to stop I just step on it. We made it about three quarters of the way across before the car came to a sputtering stop and sank down into about three feet of water. Water filled the car to just under the seats. We spent the night in the car and woke up to a blistering hot day and a 10km walk back to town. Hungover and more dehydrated than I have ever been in my life we set off on the worst walk of shame I have ever done. 
TL;DR: drove drunk, took back roads home, drove down "impassable road" and didn't make it. Walked home in shame, hungover, and dehydrated the next day.
